text: 1、中共中央政治局召开会议 审议《关于二十届中央第七轮巡视情况的综合报告》 中共中央总书记习近平主持会议； 2、习近平对西藏那曲市巴青县7.0级地震作出重要指示强调 全力开展人员搜救 妥善安置受灾群众 切实保障人民群众生命财产安全 李强作出批示； 3、应习近平邀请 德国总统将访华； 4、在新的长征路上奋力创造新的辉煌——习近平总书记在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上的重要讲话引发热烈反响； 5、李强主持召开国务院常务会议； 6、西藏那曲市巴青县7.0级地震抢险救援工作抓紧进行； 7、中央组织部从代中央管理党费中划拨2500万元用于支持西藏抗震救灾工
text_en: 1. The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to review the Comprehensive Report on the Seventh Round of Inspections of the 20th Central Committee; Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the meeting; 2. Xi Jinping issued important instructions on the 7.0-magnitude earthquake in Baqing County, Nagqu City, Tibet, emphasizing the need to make every effort to carry out search and rescue, properly resettle affected people, and effectively ensure the safety of people's lives and property; Li Qiang gave instructions; 3. At Xi Jinping's invitation, the German President will visit China; 4. Striving to create new brilliance on the new Long March—General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the meeting commemorating the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March aroused enthusiastic responses; 5. Li Qiang presided over an executive meeting of the State Council; 6. Rescue and relief work for the 7.0-magnitude earthquake in Baqing County, Nagqu City, Tibet, is being carried out urgently; 7. The Central Organization Department allocated 25 million yuan from Party dues managed on behalf of the Central Committee to support earthquake relief work in Tibet.
